headline: Pakistan beat Oman by 18 runs in the Plate final of the Hong Kong International Sixes on Sunday, with skipper Abbas Afridi scoring an unbeaten 73 off 16 balls, Express Tribune reports.

card.desc: Abbas Afridi ne 16 balls par naabad 73 runs banaye.

caption:
Hong Kong Sixes mein Pakistan ne Plate final jeet liya!
Express Tribune ke mutabiq Sunday ko Mong Kok ke Mission Road Ground par Pakistan ne Oman ko 18 runs se hara diya. Pakistan ne 6 overs mein 154-4 banaye, captain Abbas Afridi ne 16 balls par naabad 73 runs (11 chhakke) banaye aur player of the match bane, jab ke Oman 136-4 tak hi pohanch saka.
Abbas Afridi ki is innings ko kitne number denge? Comment mein batayein 👇
